thread:
Jordan: FYI NebulaCloud asked for a minimal refkit so partners can list Redwood-powered inference as a 1-click marketplace offer. They want terraform + a tiny helm chart, OIDC login, and a clear security checklist.

Priya: sounds doable. Do they expect support across AWS/GCP in the first pass?

Jordan: Nebula wants AWS first (market demand) but wants the repo to be structured so GCP/GKE is straightforward later.

Luis: proposal: repo `redwood-refkit-micro` with layout: `terraform/aws/`, `charts/refkit/`, `examples/`, `docs/`. Terraform module should create: networking (VPC/subnets), compute (ASG or nodepool), ALB + listeners, optional IAM role for marketplace ingestion, and an `outputs` block that the helm chart can consume.

Anika: must include OIDC/workload-identity option for SaaS connectors. Also add `enable_kms` and `kms_key_arn` variables. For private registries support both ECR & GCR via `image.registry` override in values.yaml.

Jordan: can we keep terraform variables minimal? the partners like a tiny surface: `region`, `instance_class`, `image`, `enable_kms`, `enable_oidc`. Advanced knobs in `examples/advanced`.

Luis: agree. Sample TF snippet for aws module: 

```
module "redwood_refkit" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkit-micro//terraform/aws"
  region = "us-east-1"
  instance_class = "m6i.large"
  image = "111122223333.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/refkit:0.1.0"
  enable_kms = true
  enable_oidc = true
}
```

Priya: CI expectations? We should run `terraform fmt/validate`, `terratest` smoke with mocked credentials or small sandbox account, `helm lint`, and a smoke deploy that curls `/readyz` on the sample service. Keep runtime costs minimal.

Anika: add a security checklist in docs: least-priv IAM, no wide-open S3 permissions, KMS optional, registry auth patterns, and marketplace packaging checklist for Nebula (license + contact info + security whitepaper).

Jordan: timeline: Nebula submitted deadline in ~12 days. Can we commit to a partner-ready artifact in 10 days?

Luis: I'll scaffold terraform + helm today, aim for first PR in 3 days.

Priya: I'll own CI and the smoke harness. Plan: sandbox creds in CI (short-lived) and a job that tears down resources. I'll add cost-estimate step.

Anika: I'll draft docs & security checklist. Also will prepare a short README that marketplace-ops can use for listing copy.

marketplace-ops: tagging in case we need marketplace metadata. We require logo, short description, support contact, and compliance checkbox for Nebula listing.

infra-bot: New repo created: github.com/redwood-inference/refkit-micro (private). Default branch: main.

Jordan: perfect. Owners: Luis (module/helm), Priya (CI), Anika (docs/security), Jordan (partner PM). Delivery target: demo to NebulaCloud on 1717710000.

Priya: I'll open GH issues for CI tasks and link a checklist.

Luis: will include a tiny example app that calls Redwood hosted API by default and flips to private via env var `REDWOOD_DEPLOYMENT=private`.

Anika: adding note: include `kv_cache_persistent` option and docs on acceptable disk sizes. Also a pointer on quantization flags for cost-sensitive partners.

Jordan: good catch. Also add an acceptance criteria section in README: minimal IAM, CI passes, helm chart linted, sample /readyz passes, marketplace metadata present.

marketplace-ops: will review once PR is opened; we can fast-track Nebula listings if criteria are met.

Jordan: thanks all. Keep messages short in PRs. We want the partner artifact to be very prescriptive 1 small surface, strong defaults.

(End of thread)
